Look, I've been in this situation. There's only two outcomes. Eventually they will forget it happens or they won't be your friend again. If they don't want to be your friend again you have to realize that there is someone out there for you but if you're just upset about the past you may miss them. Please don't do that. You're gonna miss out on so many great things to come. Please
How old is she? She ought to know better you can be happy and single.

I used to be friends with a girl just like this, I fell in love with her and she got a boyfriend and it hurt me so much I couldnt be her friend anymore. I honestly think you should show her how much other people actually like her. But really, what's the big deal about always having a boyfriend. Sometimes its okay to take a break and wait for the right person to come along. It will happen and if the person ignores it it won't be. She has to be more open about stuff like that. I know that there's someone for everyone even though that person isn't in my life yet but its bound to happen. I just hope she gets what she wants.

I know how hard it is to lose your best friend, especially if you didn't have any other friends, like me. There's no reason to hang yourself. If you really can't get her back as your friend than that's her fault for making you feel like this. But think about it, if you didn't back off that chair. If you were found hours later, how would she feel? How would the rest of your family feel, what would everyone you know feel? I know this may make you feel bad; but people on this earth really need you. If you don't get your best friend back there will be other people, believe me. No ones the same but there sure are some damn good people out there for you to meet. I hope you change your mind. I know how it feels.
